The build command isn't shown anywhere in this section, and `--keep-float` is not documented here. A first-time reader doesn't know how to build an index.

point: `remex search INDEX QUERY_FILE` reads comma-separated query vectors, one per line, and prints nearest neighbours as JSON Lines. `-k` and `--bits` control the result count and search precision, and rescoring only happens if the index was built with `--keep-float`.
